settings.palette_mode.label: Cover color mode
settings.palette_mode.description: Use one dominant cover color or a gradient of up to four cover colors around the border.
settings.idle_mode.label: Without cover art
settings.idle_mode.description: Choose what the border shows when no active player or usable cover art is available.
settings.fallback_color.label: Fallback color
settings.fallback_color.description: Color used when Without cover art is set to Fixed color.
settings.silence_brightness.label: Silence brightness
settings.silence_brightness.description: Base border brightness when the audio spectrum is zero, from 0% to 100%.
settings.spectrum_gain.label: Spectrum sensitivity
settings.spectrum_gain.description: How strongly local frequency bands brighten the border, from 0% to 300%.
settings.bass_gain.label: Bass boost
settings.bass_gain.description: How strongly the lowest frequency band brightens the whole border, from 0% to 150%.
settings.max_colors.label: Maximum cover colors
settings.max_colors.description: Limit the number of distinct cover colors used by the gradient.
settings.gradient_speed.label: Gradient rotation speed
settings.gradient_speed.description: Rotation speed from -50% to 50%. Negative values reverse direction; zero keeps colors still.
settings.dark_color_floor.label: Dark color boost
settings.dark_color_floor.description: Raise very dark cover colors to this minimum peak channel, from 0% to 100%, before applying brightness.
